messages:
alex: heads up — saw a wave of preemptions in APAC spot pools between 00:30-01:20 UTC. ~10% of running slices got evicted, tail latencies +120ms for several tenants. suspect the stratified spot/reserve scheduler + tight bin-packing amplified fragmentation.

maya: can you paste the eviction log or the policy we applied? curious if the scale-down was abrupt or staggered.

alex: pasted the policy & recent scaling block:
```yaml
scheduler: stratified
tiers: [guaranteed, reserved_burst, spot_preempt]
shrink_policy: immediate
packing: binpack_by_gpu_memory_then_age
packing_ripple_threshold: 0.12
defrag_window: 02:00-04:00
```
there was an autoscaler job that flipped shrink_policy -> immediate at 00:25 UTC for APAC spot pools.

jin: quick thought: our usual fragmentation metric (free_slots_ratio) doesn't capture inter-slice gaps. i propose a "fracture_index":
fracture_index = 1 - (largest_contiguous_free_gpus / total_free_gpus).
if fracture_index > 0.6, packing is going to create a lot of tiny leftovers that reserved slices can't use.

sam: agree. also seeing "packing ripple" where evicting a 4-GPU spot causes a chain of 1- and 2-GPU preempts due to greedy fitting. proposal: prefer slot-preserving binpack for guaranteed/reserved tiers, allow spot to be spread across nodes as a last resort.

ops: forecast question — how much buffer are we assuming APAC needs for the next 6 weeks? cc @maya for traffic forecast.

alex: current forecast (model + campaign inputs): extra ~1800 GPU-hours/day for APAC over baseline for next 6 weeks (holiday promos + new partner tests). baseline daily hours ~28k -> peak ~29.8k-31.0k depending on promo cadence. cost delta if we shift 40% to reserved vs spot is ~+22% committed cost but reduces preemption risk by ~70%.

maya: operational mitigation ideas:
- soften binpack for reserved tier: binpack_by_tenant_cohort_then_model_size
- add defrag task during low-util window but with prewarm to avoid cold-start latency
- implement a short-term "spot spread" policy that places spot shards across nodes to reduce contiguous holes
example scheduling rule: 
```json
{"placement_order": ["guaranteed","reserved","spot"], "spot_spread": true, "max_frag_threshold": 0.2}
```

deploy-bot: applied canary config to apac-spot-pool at 02:10 UTC: packer.mode=spread, shrink_policy=staggered, canary=10%.

jin: canary logs look ok but we need sims for fairness: running Monte Carlo sim for tenant cohorts (small, medium, large) to estimate tail eviction delta. estimated runtime ~45m.

sam: i'll run the simulation and drop results in this thread. also volunteering to run a 3-hour aggressive defrag during the 04:00-07:00 UT window if ops signs off.

ops: please include cost delta in sim outputs (reserved vs spot, defrag overhead). i'll ok the defrag once we have numbers and a rollback plan.

alex: action items:
- sam: run sim + cost calc (ETA 45m)
- jin: fracture_index runbook + alert rule (fracture_index > 0.45 -> hold new large placements)
- maya: update scheduler canary to 25% if sim looks good
- ops: confirm defrag window and rollback checklist

alex: thanks team — keeping this thread as the coordination point. ping @ops if anything changes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
